evidence_added: rso/witness/run_witness.py: `launch` runs a registered (subject genome file, arm, predicate, seeds) list as ONE ledgered TOP_LEVEL launch against Ledger.from_contract via ares_client; node rows are RECEIPT rows with parent_run_id and receipt_sha256; bundle = receipts/, subjects/, seeds.json, inventory.json, run.json, MANIFEST.json (written last, carries launch_run_id)

`subject` runs ares.search.run for a registered subject config and records genome.json, its sha256 (equal to ares_client.genome_digest), the run receipt and EVERY episode seed the GA drew (training draws per generation via a pass-through rollout recorder, plus held-out sets); log, held-out and fitness are discarded and not printed

refusals before any ledger row: unknown arm, empty/non-integer/duplicate seeds, duplicate node, seed below seed_floor, seed in EVAL_SEEDS / balanced_seeds_for / an excluded subject record, non-canonical subject file, S-NOPL seeds differing from S seeds in value or order (T017 requirement: p_chan pairs by position), non-empty output directory

24 plumbing tests: bundle binds (binding_reasons == [] for every receipt), one TOP_LEVEL row, second run uses a new launch and a repeated id is refused, cheat controls (edited receipt -> BIND_DIGEST_MISMATCH, receipt under the other launch -> BIND_FOREIGN_LAUNCH), seed record complete and generation-0 draw independently replayed, failed node -> FAILED rows and no MANIFEST, cap exhaustion -> REFUSED row and exit 3

evidence_executed.command: 5 mutants (pairing check off, parent_run_id dropped, receipt_sha256 dropped, rollout wrapper not restored, exclusion off)

red_observed.detail: driver module absent: test module failed to import before run_witness.py was written

known_escapes: no registered subject was run and no statistic was computed: the registered subject configs (P=128, G=120) are C-010's first act after the preregistration freezes; subject-run tests use P=4, G=1 random-init GA runs
the P-ERASE probe set and P-PRES seed set (PREREG_DRAFT OPEN 2) are not driven here: the driver runs any registered (subject, arm, predicate, seeds) list but has no episode-pair/probe construction

AR.rollout is wrapped by monkeypatch for the duration of a subject run; if ares.search.run is changed to call rollout through another name the recorder would record nothing (the replay test of generation 0 would then fail)
bundle holds receipts but not the action-trace bytes: ares_client.receipt_dict does not return them (Cadmus's file, not edited)
